purpose: Structure-only provenance screen of the published ARMAP ScienceWorld reward-model training corpus; no controller outcomes are evaluated.

scan.output_policy: Aggregate counts, schema keys, pinned input identity, and explicit held-out-ID field cardinality only. Never emit raw strings, labels, preferences, trajectories, task names from records, or matching variation IDs.
scan.interpretation_limit: Absence of explicit identifier metadata does not establish sample disjointness; term hits indicate topical overlap risk only, not exact task or variation overlap.
